description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with various criteria. The vertical axis, labeled "Criterion," displays seven categorical labels. The horizontal axis, labeled "Number of Participants," features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 2 and corresponding vertical grid lines. The bars are sorted in descending order of their values from top to bottom, and each bar is visually emphasized by an annotation of its exact numerical value positioned immediately to its right. The longest bar at the top, labeled "Relevant FCs," is dark purple-grey and represents a value of 6. Moving downwards, the subsequent bars are "FC Summary" (dark blue-grey, value 5), "Relevance Explanation" (dark teal-grey, value 3), "Clarity and Simplicity" (dark green-teal, value 3), and "Overall Summary" (dark green, value 2). The two shortest bars at the bottom, "Filters" (olive green) and "Veracity Explanation" (yellowish-olive green), each have a value of 1. The colors of the bars transition smoothly along a gradient from dark purple-grey at the top to yellowish-olive green at the bottom.
